segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yeah, so quick gut check on Northstar Packaging before I send the pricing sheet to deal desk. They want to add 18 viewer seats and 6 editor seats for the plant managers.

segments.speaker: Evan
segments.text: Okay. Current package is 42 editors, right? And support is standard, not premium?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yep, 42 editors, 110 viewers, standard support. Usage is clean. The only weird thing is procurement asked whether the added seats can be cotermed on one invoice.

segments.speaker: Evan
segments.text: Billing tool shows their line running through 7/31, so after that it just has the overage tab, no recurring row. Have you put anything in front of Karen yet?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Not yet. I was trying to get the seat math right first, and Karen's been out at the Ohio site. I can send her the two-option note today.

segments.speaker: Evan
segments.text: Do that. For the 24 seats, list the prorated amount at $8,460 if it starts August 12, and the full annual at $31,920. Deal desk will ask for both anyway.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Okay. And if they push for monthly billing, do we care? Their last three invoices were net 30 and paid inside 20 days.

segments.speaker: Evan
segments.text: Monthly is fine if finance signs off, but don't lead with it. Also keep the services line separate: four admin training hours at $1,200, not bundled.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Got it. I'll draft it as option A annual, option B monthly with finance approval, seat counts called out, and target go-live August 19.

segments.speaker: Evan
segments.text: Perfect. Send me the note before it goes out, just so we don't have pricing and the CRM saying different things.
